const InterjectionMessagePrefix = "interject:"

func (*RepositoryInspector) InspectionCapabilities() engine.InspectionCapabilities

func (a *Adapter) Cancel(_ context.Context, id string) error

func (a *Adapter) Capabilities() engine.Capabilities

func (a *Adapter) CheckFork(ctx context.Context, fork engine.ForkPoint) error

func (a *Adapter) Descriptor() engine.Descriptor

func (a *Adapter) Execute(parent context.Context, request engine.Request, sink func(engine.Event) error) error

func (a *Adapter) Interject(_ context.Context, id string, input engine.Interjection) error

func (a *Adapter) RespondPermission(ctx context.Context, id, requestID string, decision engine.PermissionDecision) error

func (i *RepositoryInspector) Child(ctx context.Context, scope engine.InspectionScope, sequence uint64) (engine.InspectionChild, error)

func (i *RepositoryInspector) Export(ctx context.Context, scope engine.InspectionScope, highWater uint64, children bool) (engine.InspectionBundle, error)

func (i *RepositoryInspector) Observe(ctx context.Context, scope engine.InspectionScope, after uint64, sink func(engine.InspectionPage) error) error

func (i *RepositoryInspector) Page(ctx context.Context, scope engine.InspectionScope, query engine.InspectionQuery) (engine.InspectionPage, error)

func (i *RepositoryInspector) Read(ctx context.Context, scope engine.InspectionScope, uri string, offset int64) (engine.InspectionText, error)

func (interjectionPlugin) Name() string

func (p interjectionPlugin) Register(_ context.Context, r *core.Registrar) error

func InterjectionPlugin(take func() []engine.Interjection, delivered func(engine.Interjection) error) core.Plugin

func New(factory RunnerFactory) *Adapter

func NewConfigured(factory RunnerFactory, respond PermissionResponder, options FactoryOptions) *Adapter

func NewRepositoryInspector(repository Storage) (*RepositoryInspector, error)

func NewWithPermissions(factory RunnerFactory, respond PermissionResponder) *Adapter

type Adapter struct {
}

type FactoryOptions struct {
	SystemPrompt, MaxTurns, Generation, DurableWaits, FileInputs, SkillInputs bool

	ContextCompaction bool

	Interjection, Fork bool

	CheckFork func(context.Context, engine.ForkPoint) error
}

type OwnedRunner interface {
	harness.Runner
	Close(context.Context) error
}

type PermissionResponder func(context.Context, string, string, engine.PermissionDecision) error

type RepositoryInspector struct{}

type RunnerFactory func(context.Context, string, engine.Request, bool) (harness.Runner, error)

type Storage interface {
	storage.Records
	storage.References
	storage.ChildReader
	storage.Bundles
}
